name: WdInternationalIndex
description: Specifies information specific to the current country/region and international settings.

constants.name: wdListSeparator
constants.description: Returns the list separator (, in U.S. English).

constants.name: wdDecimalSeparator
constants.description: Returns the decimal separator (. in U.S. English).

constants.name: wdThousandsSeparator
constants.description: Returns the thousands separator (, in U.S. English).

constants.name: wdCurrencyCode
constants.description: Returns the currency symbol ($ in U.S. English).

constants.name: wd24HourClock
constants.description: Returns True if you are using 24-hour time; returns False if you are using 12-hour time.

constants.name: wdInternationalAM
constants.description: Returns the string used to indicate morning hours (for example, 10 A.M).

constants.name: wdInternationalPM
constants.description: Returns the string used to indicate afternoon and evening hours (for example, 2 P.M).

constants.name: wdTimeSeparator
constants.description: Returns the time separator (: in U.S. English).

constants.name: wdDateSeparator
constants.description: Returns the date separator (/ in U.S. English).

constants.name: wdProductLanguageID
constants.description: Returns the language version of Word.
